The ticket, independent approval and approval-on-head requirements are met, and no security-sensitive or protected paths are touched. The CI evidence cannot be relied on: the JUnit reports were produced on a host named dev-laptop-7.local rather than the recorded CI executor, at a time inconsistent with the run. Passing tests on the final commit are therefore not established, and the change is held until a genuine CI run on 2e3d5224 is supplied.
